name_check.text:
Would your name happen to
be {player}? Good, good!

phone.text:
I just now had a phone call
about you, hm?

made_it.text:
Whew! I'm glad I made it
here in time to meet your
train. I'm afraid I'm not in
the best shape of my life...

intro.text:
But I ramble! My name is
Tom Nook.

store.text:
I, uh, run the
store here in town. I'm quite
pleased to meet you, yes?

odd.text:
Something strikes me as odd,
though, my young friend.
Moving to a town before
settling on a place to live...

madness.text:
Why, it's the craziest thing I
have ever heard of! Madness!
Absolute madness, hm?
Whoa ho ho ho ho ho ho!

pardon.text:
Whoa ho! Ho ho! Ah, ahem.
Pardon me, I beg you! That
just struck my funny bone.

have_house.text:
It may be small, but I have
a house you can move into
right away! It should more
than suit your needs, hm?

come_along.text:
I can show it to you now,
so come along! Let's scuttle!
